title: Railway agent tool says the variable was updated, but the deployed value never changes
symptoms: Agent reports applied or staged for deployment
Redeploy happens, yet the service still logs the old value
cause: The railway-agent tool cannot see secret values (hidden from agent), so it cannot verify its own change, and it reported success three times while the live value stayed the same.
fix: Set variables with the CLI and verify in the runtime log, not in the agent's reply.
apply: railway link --project <id> --environment <env> --service <svc> && railway variables --set "NAME=value" && railway redeploy --yes
